dict.string: Nuke the currently-playing Spotify track from every owned playlist except Nuked. Companion to vdesabou/alfred-spotify-mini-player.

spnuke is a companion to the Spotify Mini Player workflow. It reuses that workflow's cached library and OAuth credentials (read-only) to move the currently-playing track to a playlist named "Nuked" and remove it from every other playlist you own. Liked Songs are untouched.
Requires: macOS, Alfred Powerpack, Spotify Mini Player installed & authenticated, PHP 8.1+ on PATH (e.g. `brew install php`).
Trigger: type `nuke` in Alfred while Spotify is playing.
Move current track to "Nuked" and remove from all other owned playlists.

# Alfred sets $PWD to the workflow install directory. cd "$PWD" || exit 0
# Find a usable php. Alfred Run Script actions run with a minimal PATH that # typically excludes /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin, so we look there # explicitly. /usr/bin/php is gone on modern macOS; we still probe it for # users who installed via MacPorts or similar. for PHP_BIN in /opt/homebrew/bin/php /usr/local/bin/php /opt/local/bin/php /usr/bin/php "$(command -v php 2>/dev/null)"; do if [ -x "$PHP_BIN" ]; then exec "$PHP_BIN" src/nuke.php fi done
# No PHP found — surface a notification and exit cleanly. /usr/bin/osascript -e 'display notification "PHP not found on PATH. Install with: brew install php" with title "spnuke"' exit 0
